claims.quote: WES revealed that the proband has harbored a heterozygous c.1642C>T (p.Arg548Cys) missense variant in exon 15 of the NPRL3 gene.
The clinical phenotype of FFEVF patients caused by variants of NPRL3 gene is extensive, and the patients may present with neurological abnormality of autism spectrum disorder in addition to seizures.
